name: Todd Blanche
description: Follow Todd Blanche, a tracked person, in Lootura: recent changes, timeline, related context, and source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Morning news brief
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche to appear for confirmation hearing, U.S. restarts blockade against Iran amid standoff over the Strait of Hormuz, ICE suspends traffic stops after deadly shootings.

changes.title: Todd Blanche Faces Crucial Hurdle Ahead of Confirmation as Attorney General
changes.summary: Todd Blanche’s nomination is broadly a referendum on President Trump’s vision of the Justice Department as a projection of his power.

changes.title: Sen. Adam Schiff, D-Calif., on the confirmation hearing for AG nominee Todd Blanche
changes.summary: NPR's Leila Fadel asks Democratic Sen. Adam Schiff what he plans to ask Attorney General nominee Todd Blanche at his confirmation hearing.

changes.title: Acting AG Todd Blanche faces a key test. And, ICE pauses most traffic stops
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche is set to appear before the Senate for his confirmation hearing. And, Immigration and Customs Enforcement has paused most traffic stops after recent deadly shootings. (Image credit: Ken Cedeno).

changes.title: Todd Blanche's confirmation brings one Epstein survivor to center stage
changes.summary: Dani Bensky and a group of women who were abused by Jeffrey Epstein have formed a bond they call a "survivor sisterhood." They live in two worlds, of advocacy and everyday life and motherhood. (Image credit: Corrie Aune for NPR).

changes.title: As Confirmation Hearing Nears, Todd Blanche’s Role in Epstein Case Draws Scrutiny
changes.summary: Todd Blanche’s role in interviewing Ghislaine Maxwell, a longtime associate of the convicted sex offender Jeffrey Epstein, will be front and center as he seeks to become attorney general.

changes.title: Blanche set to face harsh questioning at Senate confirmation hearing
changes.summary: Acting Attorney General Todd Blanche will appear Wednesday before the Senate Judiciary Committee for his confirmation hearing to take over the role on a permanent basis.

changes.title: Discovered by Atlas
changes.summary: Todd Blanche first entered the public knowledge record with source-backed evidence.

changes.title: Blanche Stares Down Confirmation Hurdle: Lingering G.O.P. Doubts
changes.summary: Key Republicans on the Judiciary Committee could push for concessions from Todd Blanche, in line to be attorney general, though they did not appear in revolt.
